verdict.rationale: Slack documents Workflow Builder as a no-code way to combine steps and triggers into automations, offers webhook triggers, and supports Slack-hosted TypeScript workflows via the Deno SDK. None of this evidence explicitly mentions a scheduled, time-based, or recurring trigger, so recurring scheduling is only implied by the generic "triggers" wording. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/recurring triggers, cron-style or interval configuration, programmatic (CLI/API) schedule management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
